challenger.notes: The diagnosis matches the historical admission race and the paused-allocation regression is directly discriminative. The proposal retains existing capacity, waiting, dependency, ownership, and operator boundaries without adding speculative architecture; its intended REVIEW route is appropriate after DEV verification. Downstream REVIEW nevertheless exposed a missing surviving-page crash-window regression and an accepted-Send replay risk not covered by this proposal.

champion.notes: Correctly identifies the same-endpoint admission race, keeps the change bounded to existing owners, preserves dependency and ownership constraints, and proposes a regression that would expose concurrent admission. REVIEW is the appropriate post-DEV route. However, downstream REVIEW found an uncovered crash window in the persisted continuation-started state that could replay Send, so the proposed verification/fix boundary is not fully aligned with later evidence.
